% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Generated MILP for service‑oriented railway timetable rescheduling.
%@ meta id=railway_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Service-oriented railway timetable rescheduling with seat reservation
%@ desc :: MILP model that decides new departure times of trains at stations, ordering binaries, and time‑slot assignment binaries to respect headway and station capacity, minimizing weighted passenger delay during disruptions.
%@ tags :: milp | railway | rescheduling | seat_reservation
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations.
%@ index Θ ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time slots.
%@ index TT ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Ordered train pairs (t,t') with t ≠ t'.
%@ param orig shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Original scheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ param pax shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Number of passengers on train t when leaving station s.
%@ param head shape=TT,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Minimum headway required between ordered pair (t,t') at station s.
%@ param cap shape=S,Θ kind=matrix domain=integer :: Station capacity: maximum number of departures allowed at station s in time slot τ.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=time :: Big‑M constant for ordering constraints.
%@ var d shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: New departure time of train t at station s.
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Positive delay of train t at station s.
%@ var x shape=T,S,Θ domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: Binary: 1 if train t departs station s at time slot τ.
%@ var y shape=TT,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: Ordering binary: y_{t,t',s}=1 if train t departs before train t' at station s.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_delay combination=sum :: Minimize total weighted passenger delay.
%@ con dep_time kind=linear domain=definition indicator=- :: Departure time equals weighted sum of time‑slot binaries.
%@ con delay_def kind=linear domain=definition indicator=- :: Delay lower bound.
%@ con depart_once kind=linear domain=assignment indicator=- :: Each train departs each station exactly once.
%@ con headway kind=linear domain=ordering indicator=- :: Headway constraint between ordered train pair at a station.
%@ con ordering_sum kind=linear domain=definition indicator=- :: Exactly one ordering direction for each train pair at a station.
%@ con capacity kind=linear domain=capacity indicator=- :: Station capacity per time slot.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T},\, s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{pax}_{t,s} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{t,s} \tag{total_delay} \\
  & d_{t,s} - \sum_{\tau \in \Theta} \tau \cdot x_{t,s,\tau} = 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{dep_time} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{t,s} - d_{t,s} + \mathit{orig}_{t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay_def} \\
  & \sum_{\tau \in \Theta} x_{t,s,\tau} = 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{depart_once} \\
  & d_{t',s} - d_{t,s} - \mathit{head}_{t,t',s} + \mathit{M} \cdot (1 - y_{t,t',s}) \ge 0 \qquad \forall (t,t') \in \mathcal{TT},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{headway} \\
  & y_{t,t',s} + y_{t',t,s} = 1 \qquad \forall (t,t') \in \mathcal{TT},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{ordering_sum} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{t,s,\tau} \le \mathit{cap}_{s,\tau} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall \tau \in \Theta \tag{capacity}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Railway service‑oriented timetable rescheduling with seat reservation.
%@ meta id=reschedule_milp family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Service‑oriented railway rescheduling MILP
%@ desc :: MILP model for train retiming, reordering, local rerouting and seat‑reservation‑based passenger inconvenience minimization under headway and station‑capacity constraints.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ param base shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Baseline (original) departure time of train t at station s.
%@ param headway shape=T,T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Minimum required time gap between trains t1 and t2 at station s.
%@ param w shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_weight :: Weighted passenger inconvenience coefficient for train t at station s.
%@ param cap shape=S kind=vector domain=capacity :: Maximum number of trains that can occupy station s simultaneously.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=big_M :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ param p_reroute shape=- kind=scalar domain=penalty :: Penalty coefficient for using a reroute.
%@ var d shape=T,S domain=integer role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Scheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ var o shape=T,T,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Ordering binary: o_{t1,t2,s}=1 if t1 passes before t2 at s.
%@ var z shape=T,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Reroute indicator for train t at station s.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Presence indicator of train t at station s.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_inconvenience combination=sum :: Minimize total passenger inconvenience and reroute penalties.
%@ con baseline kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Baseline schedule adherence.
%@ con headway_forward kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway enforcement (forward direction).
%@ con headway_reverse kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway enforcement (reverse direction).
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station capacity limit.
%@ con link_time kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Linking departure time to presence.
%@ con reroute_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Reroute can only occur if train is present.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{w}_{t,s} \cdot d_{t,s} \;+\; \mathit{p\_reroute} \cdot z_{t,s} \tag{total\_inconvenience} \\
  & d_{t,s} \ge \mathit{base}_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{baseline} \\
  & d_{t2,s} - d_{t1,s} + \mathit{M} \cdot o_{t1,t2,s} \ge \mathit{headway}_{t1,t2,s} \qquad \forall t1 \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall t2 \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; t1 \neq t2 \tag{headway\_forward} \\
  & d_{t1,s} - d_{t2,s} + \mathit{M} - \mathit{M} \cdot o_{t1,t2,s} \ge \mathit{headway}_{t1,t2,s} \qquad \forall t1 \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall t2 \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; t1 \neq t2 \tag{headway\_reverse} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{t,s} \le \mathit{cap}_{s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{capacity} \\
  & d_{t,s} \le \mathit{M} \cdot y_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{link\_time} \\
  & z_{t,s} - y_{t,s} \le 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{reroute\_link}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Service-oriented train rescheduling with passenger inconvenience (MILP)
%@ meta id=train_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Service-oriented train rescheduling under disruptions
%@ desc :: MILP model for train retiming, reordering and local rerouting that minimizes weighted passenger delay while respecting headway and station capacity constraints. The model uses a space‑time network with binary assignment of trains to discrete departure slots and ordering variables for incompatible train pairs.
%@ tags :: milp | railway | timetable | passenger_inconvenience | headway | capacity
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index K ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time slots.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Incompatible triples (t1,t2,s) where trains t1 and t2 cannot occupy station s within the required headway.
%@ param cost shape=T,K kind=matrix domain=cost :: Penalty coefficient for assigning train t to time slot k (includes passenger delay cost).
%@ param H shape=T,T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Minimum headway (in time units) required between train t1 and train t2 at station s.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M formulation.
%@ param a shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=bool :: Indicator =1 if train t visits station s, 0 otherwise.
%@ param cap shape=S kind=vector domain=integer :: Maximum number of trains that can occupy station s simultaneously.
%@ param time shape=K kind=vector domain=time :: Physical time value of slot k.
%@ var y shape=T,K domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Binary assignment of train t to departure time slot k.
%@ var z shape=I domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Ordering variable: 1 if train t1 departs before train t2 at station s.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total weighted passenger inconvenience.
%@ con assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train is assigned to exactly one time slot.
%@ con headway1 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway constraint (t1 before t2) for incompatible triples.
%@ con headway2 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway constraint (t2 before t1) for incompatible triples.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station capacity constraint.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T},\, k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{cost}_{t,k} \cdot y_{t,k} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} y_{t,k} = 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{assign} \\
  & \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{time}_{k} \cdot y_{t1,k}
      + \mathit{H}_{t1,t2,s}
      \le \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{time}_{k} \cdot y_{t2,k}
      + \mathit{M} \cdot (1 - z_{t1,t2,s})
      \qquad \forall (t1,t2,s) \in \mathcal{I} \tag{headway1} \\
  & \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{time}_{k} \cdot y_{t2,k}
      + \mathit{H}_{t1,t2,s}
      \le \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{time}_{k} \cdot y_{t1,k}
      + \mathit{M} \cdot z_{t1,t2,s}
      \qquad \forall (t1,t2,s) \in \mathcal{I} \tag{headway2} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} a_{t,s} \cdot y_{t,k} \le \mathit{cap}_{s}
      \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall k \in \mathcal{K} \tag{capacity}
\end{align}
